name: Cultural Building Payments
description:
The Minister of Culture is herby made responsible to make a design for the Culture Districts and through setting the ammounts in the payout account set standard payments of the different materials.

This work shall be done by the group "Culture Builder" Those to include in the groups is at full discretion of the Minister of Culture and Prime Minister who can set requiremnts and requlations before adding them to those titles. The Minister of Culture does remain responsable for the end result of the work that is done.

If additional payments besides the set standard payments through the payout accounts are required they can be done through contracts as desired.

properties.Title: Payment account protection
properties.UserDescription: Protect the payment account that are used as configuration to set the different payouts for materials to be changed by anyone except the Miniuster of Culture. If the Minister is not available for a longer period and/or there is a high priority to change the payments the Prime Minister is the backup to change the ammounts in the payment accounts.
